name: _mobile.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  star-field/_mobile.scss — the <768px overrides: drawer and dossier panel
//  become full-width sheets, the HUD compacts, tooltip hides, and controls
//  move to the small-screen gutter.
//  Imported by star-field.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@media (max-width: $bk-768) {
  // Canvas stays fullscreen — only the chrome sheets track the gutter.
  // Both sheets cap at 40vh with identical bottom margin so the scene
  // keeps the upper half clear; the nav and instructions are scrollable.
  .#{$_B_SF}-nav {
    top: auto;
    left: to-rem($space-md);
    right: to-rem($space-md);
    width: auto;
    bottom: to-rem($space-md);
    max-height: 40vh;
    max-height: 40dvh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .#{$_B_SF}-nav-panel {
    height: 100%;
    max-height: 100%;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
  }

  // The docked strip still reaches the card top (the panel's 3xl pad
  // is unchanged) but a 40vh sheet can't afford the desktop header
  // pad — tighter insets keep the list readable under it.
  .#{$_B_SF}-nav-pin {
    padding-top: to-rem($space-md);
  }

  .#{$_B_SF}-nav-search {
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-md);
  }

  .#{$_B_SF}-panel {
    top: auto;
    left: to-rem($space-md);
    right: to-rem($space-md);
    width: auto;
    bottom: to-rem($space-md);
    max-height: 50vh;
    max-height: 50dvh;
  }

  .#{$_B_SF}-instructions-btn {
    display: inline-block;
  }

  .#{$_B_SF}-instructions-modal {
    position: absolute;
    left: to-rem($space-md);
    right: to-rem($space-md);
    bottom: to-rem($space-md);
    z-index: 50;
    max-height: 40vh;
    max-height: 40dvh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    padding: to-rem($space-xl);
    background: var(--sf-chrome);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-md));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-md));
    border: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-line);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-hover);
    color: var(--sf-ink);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: to-rem($space-md);
  }

  .#{$_B_SF}-instructions-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  .#{$_B_SF}-instructions-title {
    font-size: to-rem($space-md);
    font-weight: 300;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: var(--sf-ink-strong);
    margin: 0;
  }

  .#{$_B_SF}-instructions-close {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    line-height: 1;
    color: var(--sf-ink);
    background: var(--sf-chrome-2);
    border: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-line);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition:
      color 0.2s ease,
      border-color 0.2s ease;

    &:hover,
    &:focus-visible {
      color: var(--sf-ink-strong);
      border-color: var(--sf-ink-2);
    }
  }

  .#{$_B_SF}-instructions-body {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: to-rem($space-sm);
  }

  .#{$_B_SF}-instructions-hint,
  .#{$_B_SF}-instructions-disclaimer {
    font-size: to-rem($space-md);
    font-weight: 300;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--sf-ink);
    line-height: to-rem($space-lg);
  }

  // The scale disclaimer moves inside the nav drawer on small screens —
  // pinned bottom text plus two action buttons plus the hint was the
  // cluttered bottom edge; the drawer keeps it one gesture away.
  .#{$_B_SF}-disclaimer {
    display: none;
  }

  .#{$_B_SF}-nav-disclaimer {
    display: block;
  }

  .#{$_B_SF}-hud {
    top: auto;
    bottom: to-rem($space-4xl);
    width: 90%;
  }

  // The gesture hint is desktop copy ("scroll to zoom"); the aria-live
  // span stays mounted so screen-reader announcements still fire.
  .#{$_B_SF}-hint {
    display: none;
  }

  // Controls float one pad inside the small-screen frame.
  .#{$_B_SF}-nav-toggle {
    bottom: calc(#{to-rem($space-md)} * 2);
    left: calc(#{to-rem($space-md)} * 2);
  }

  .#{$_B_SF}-tip {
    display: none;
  }

  .#{$_B_SF}-actions {
    right: calc(#{to-rem($space-md)} * 2);
    bottom: calc(#{to-rem($space-md)} * 2);
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}
